reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Source-provenance assessment and burden/enrichment reanalysis with technical/ancestry and testable-universe checks.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior burden/enrichment Methods or versioned documentation to select detailed analysis conditions and verify transfer before execution. Citation/provenance lookup is separate.

Does not define a complete primary burden/enrichment estimand and model with uncertainty and a declared multiplicity family. Generic calibrated p-values, prespecification or parameter lists do not provide those inferential choices.

checks.quote: inflates significance whenever testable genes are non-randomly distributed
checks.reason: Nonrandom eligibility can inflate or deflate enrichment; the direction depends on the pathway-versus-background selection probabilities.

checks.quote: if any fails, the specific error stands
checks.reason: A failed robustness/replication check can be underpowered or technically inconclusive; the decision does not compare effect/uncertainty or specify an ambiguous branch.

Proposes new same-center matched-ancestry cases/controls and shared-sample detection checks, preserving association rather than causal proof. The alternative invalid covariate remedy is charged under P17.

checks.quote: or with genomic-control/λ and principal-component adjustment reported
checks.reason: Offers genomic control/PC adjustment as an alternative remedy without checking center-status overlap; those adjustments cannot resolve complete technical confounding.

Separates the affirmative teaching-record provenance from analysis validity and does not infer real-person misconduct. The supplied confound/ascertainment issues are considered without any additional distinct content defect beyond the recorded checks.
